config.pairs: E13 Stage 4: 46 unique of the paper's 100 draws, weighted by multiplicity
config.outer_cv: StratifiedKFold(5), no shuffle (= E13 / paper cross_val_score)
config.nested_cv: inner folds = the 4 other outer blocks; hyperparameters and memory split chosen by mean inner accuracy only

accounting.a: paper: model registers + adaptive sketch state (counters, ids, values); Gram / covariance and per-step workspace NOT counted (the paper plots exact ridge on S hashed features at machine size S)
accounting.b: true peak floats held at any time: weights, averaged copies, bias, Gram k(k+1)/2, sums, counters, ids, scalars

labels.m2_select: count-sketch supervised gene selection + exact ridge (2 passes)
labels.m0_hashridge: control: paper hashing (signed, 'jl') + exact ridge, alpha by the same nested CV
labels.m3_fd: hashing to d + Frequent Directions (rank ell) ridge, 1 pass
labels.m2_oracle_k: reference: exact |Delta| / t-score top-k genes + ridge (selection NOT memory limited), x = k
